* Self-motivated with strong initiative, ability to work in a dynamic work environment

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager at HPI

Do you envision working for a company that has the expertise of a long-standing industry leader, but the spirit of an entrepreneur? Does the thought of making a real impact motivate and energize you? If so, HPI is the place for you. Join a team that values integrity, flexibility, loyalty, compassion and dedication—we can’t wait to meet you.

**What we do**

HPI is unique. A respected industry leader that’s been serving customers for over 44 years, we’re known for our innovation and adaptability. Our experience has given us our expertise, but our forward-thinking, entrepreneurial spirit has given us our strong reputation. As a third-party administrator, we offer a suite of health and benefit solutions to employers. By joining HPI, you’ll contribute to ideas that make a real difference for employers and employees nationwide. There isn’t a challenge we won’t accept and we’re looking for people who have a passion to take it on. Not just a job—a mission.

Our commitment extends beyond our clients to our own employees. We foster a supportive and inclusive work environment where innovation thrives. By investing in our team’s growth and well-being, we ensure they are equipped to provide exceptional service.

**What you'll do,**

The Project Manager (PM) leads cross-functional projects across enterprise business units, ensuring successful delivery of scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives. The PM coordinates strategy, planning, execution, and stakeholder alignment, applying project management and business analysis practices as needed based on project size and maturity. The PM is responsible for transparent reporting, risk management, and continuous improvement within the ePMO.

**In this role, you'll also,**

* Lead project planning, strategy, and execution for enterprise initiatives.

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, track milestones and deliverables.
* Build and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies); drive mitigation and escalation.
* Identify and manage resource needs and clarify team roles and responsibilities.
* Provide concise status updates and executive-ready communications.
* Facilitate effective meetings and workshops; ensure decisions, actions, and owners are captured and tracked.
* Serve as the conduit between business stakeholders (internal/external) and technical teams to ensure shared understanding and alignment.
* Liaison between internal and external (as needed) stakeholders and resources to ensure requirements are delivered on time and within budget.
* Facilitate change requests with impact analysis; maintain version-controlled baselines for scope, schedule, and requirements.
* Surface cross-project dependencies within the ePMO portfolio and coordinate integrated timelines and handoffs.
* Uses organizational tools and communication strategies to escalate risks and roadblocks, providing clear recommendations to guide decision‑making.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, dashboards, and status reports; contribute to PMO portfolio reporting and continuous improvement.
* Adhere to PMO templates, methods, and stage gates; recommend improvements to processes and tooling.

**What you bring**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
* Recent experience (within the last two years) in health insurance/managed care or third-party administration environments.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on project leadership (IT and/or business) across the full lifecycle.
* Experience with MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Planner, or similar PM/BA toolsets.
* Strong analytical and project management skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and plans.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently in a fast-paced environment; prioritize effectively and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable interacting with executives, managers, SMEs, and external partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Service orientation; strong interpersonal and customer-facing skills.
* Integrity, ethical practice, and confidentiality.
* Strong problem solving, facilitation, and influencing without authority.
* Organization, self-motivation, and sound decision-making under time constraints.

**Why choose us?**

We’re a people-first company and value giving back to our community. Ask us about our volunteer opportunities.

Our space is a reflection of who we are—innovative, open and collaborative.

We think feeling your best is an important factor in producing great work, so we embrace a “smart casual” dress code and work at ergonomic desks.

Need to reenergize? When at our Westborough headquarters, take a break to chat in the onsite café, go for a walk on one of the beautiful trails in our office park, or get in a quick workout at one of the campus gyms.

**Our Benefits Package**

We care about you and believe the greatest gift you can give yourself, your family, and the world is a healthy you! We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package to help you lead a happy, healthy life, including:

* Medical, Dental and Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Fitness Reimbursement Benefit
* Employee Assistance Program
* Flexible Spending Account & Health Savings Account
* 401(k)and Quarterly Bonuses
* Generous Paid-Time Off& Volunteering Opportunities
* Educational Assistance & Professional Development Opportunities

So, think you want to join the HPI team? We hope to hear from you!

You can read more about us at hpitpa.com/about-us/careers/

jobs.description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

We are building intelligent systems that bring generative AI into the physical world - merging models, embodiment, and real-time perception into entirely new product experiences. As a Data Program Manager are responsible for all aspects of data acquisition for the next generation of AI products by working on cross-functional DAI (data and artificial intelligence) data programs that support Siemens’ AI and industrial AI initiatives. Here you will partner with applied science, product, engineering, and operations to design and implement pragmatic solutions for acquiring data. You will be a key interface between our product roadmap and external data offerings.  
  
The role will own multiple related workstreams and serve as a liaison across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and external data partners. The Data Program Manager will translate business and product needs into executable data programs, establish operating mechanisms, manage dependencies and risks, and drive programs through delivery.

**Key responsibilities****:**

* Manage complex, cross-functional AI data programs and interconnected workstreams from planning through delivery, aligning evolving requirements with clear objectives, milestones, and operating plans.

* Drive execution across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Security, and other stakeholders, while representing programs in leadership forums.

* Oversee end-to-end data acquisition, annotation, curation, licensing, and readiness, and manage strategic day-to-day relationships with internal and external data owners

* Establish success metrics, requirements, and acceptance criteria for data deliverables to measure progress, quality, readiness, and compliance with organizational policies.

* Identify systemic risks, resolve complex cross-organizational dependencies, and lead regular program reviews to communicate status and decisions to senior leadership.

* Manage budgets, resource planning, and vendor commitments while developing scalable governance models, templates, and operating processes to improve program efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, operations, technology programs, data programs, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs.

* Experience managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, and external partners.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including communication with senior stakeholders.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing AI, data, software, or technology programs.

* Experience with data acquisition, data annotation, data curation, or data lifecycle programs.

* Experience developing and executing data acquisition strategies that leverage frontier AI models for data discovery, generation, enrichment, transformation, and quality evaluation, with an understanding of when to apply AI-driven approaches versus traditional or human-in-the-loop methods.

* Familiarity with data governance, data privacy, licensing, or responsible AI principles.

* Experience managing strategic vendors or external data providers.

* Experience establishing program governance, operating mechanisms, or standardized processes.

Program Manager, Healthcare

**About KBS**

**Kellermeyer Bergensons Services (KBS) is the largest privately held provider of facility services in North America, servicing over 2 billion square feet of space daily**. We help industry leaders across a wide range of key verticals—including **retail, industrial and logistics, healthcare, education, manufacturing, and more**—maintain clean, efficient, and welcoming spaces that support their operations. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for team members who are dedicated, reliable, and ready to contribute to a culture built on respect, opportunity, and pride in service.

If this sounds like you, then why wait, APPLY TODAY!!

This is a 100% Remote Opportunity

This role bridges program design and field execution, with accountability for transition outcomes, service delivery consistency, and workforce readiness.

**ABOUT STORD**
---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

  

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

  

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role:
  
As a Program Manager, Professional Services, you will be the face of Stord as we grow our business and partnerships together with our customers. You will be responsible for driving the onboarding experience of new customers to Stord's supply chain solutions, as well as enabling the brand growth of existing customers as they launch new channels, services, and products to their end-customers.

**What You'll Do:**

* Maintain and successfully execute a portfolio of customer projects ranging from fulfillment onboarding to standalone (SW-only) WMS & OMS launches to Professional Services engagements; and gracefully and seamlessly adjust to rapidly changing priorities in that portfolio
* Partner with Commercial, Implementation, Integration, and Operations team members to drive and own all aspects of Stord’s onboarding process from signature through hypercare, including systems, infrastructure, SOPs/training, testing, launch, post-deployment feedback, and translating customer enhancement requests to requirements and SOPs
* Balance a number of internal and external priorities (i.e. customer business outcomes, resource limitations, tight timelines, evolving scope changes, milestone risks and project budget constraints) with discretion and thoughtfulness towards both customer and Stord goals
* Track progress and performance in customer onboarding process (meeting timelines/scope commitments, delivering revenue), including identifying and implementing new KPIs and metrics to measure and improve our existing processes
* Spearhead the design and execution of innovative technology solutions and implementation of new systems/processes for existing customers across our supply chain network, such as the deployment of new internal tools for employee use, or migrating customers from legacy systems to Stord software
* Provide feedback to refine, develop and evolve Stord’s service offering, solution design process, and onboarding process and experience for new customers
* Act as a culture warrior for Stord values, as well as an advocate for continuous improvement, by identifying opportunities and efficiencies in Supply Chain and across the organization

**What You'll Need:**

* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written), to communicate horizontally and vertically within the organization and externally to customer stakeholders, all with clarity, precision and succinctness
* Willingness to be a versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure, bold in asking for clarification when the requirement or action item is unclear, and unafraid to challenge assumptions or expectations that are unfounded
* The endless drive and resilience to remove barriers and enable teams to complete their objectives, and the charisma to lead and bring together members from functional, technical and operational to achieve program goals
* Experience in a cross-functional, customer-oriented change role such as a consultant, manager, or customer implementation manager in a supply chain services, SaaS, and/or consulting environment
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities, mitigating risks, and effectively managing limited resources
* Enthusiastic desire to continuously iterate and improve existing tools and processes, with customer obsession and successful business outcomes as core drivers
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for customer-critical milestones such as kickoffs and go-lives; building strong customer relationships and leveraging effective partnership across local & remote Stord teams will be critical to your success in this role

**Strongly Encouraged:**

* Supply Chain or Logistics experience – in particular in implementing WMS, OMS, SaaS and/or fulfillment solutions
* Functional and/or technical solution design experience
* Transformation experience – including business process change management and experience sunsetting legacy systems

jobs.title: Project Manager, Verified Repacks
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We’re looking for a ***Project Manager*** to join our *Marketplace / Monetization team* to run the day-to-day operational engine behind two of our fastest-moving programs: PSA Verified, our branded graded-card repack product, and Vault as a Service (VaaS), our vaulting infrastructure for partners. You’ll be the person who turns approved work into shipped product, clean inventory records, and accurate billing, keeping production, procurement, and reporting moving on a tight monthly cadence.

  

You’ll work across the Vault floor, Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Creative, Marketing, and internal customer teams, and you’ll be the operations-level point of contact for our partners, tracking inventory in and out, communicating shipping updates, and resolving the issues that come up in-flight. If you like owning execution, untangling problems, and being the reason things ship on time, this is your role.

  

You’ll report to the *Head of Strategic Initiatives, Marketplace* . *Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.*

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own the production pipeline for PSA Verified end to end: schedule and track every series, keep delivery dates and outstanding items current, run the weekly pipeline review with Vault Operations, and create the withdrawals, packing notes, and order-prep documentation that drive each production run.
* Serve as the operations-level point of contact for partners on both programs, tracking inbound and outbound inventory flow, communicating shipping updates and processing statuses, and coordinating across the Vault and internal customer teams to resolve customer issues and work orders.
* Manage packaging and supplies procurement: place and track vendor orders, submit Purchase Requisitions and shepherd them to a PO, route invoices, and coordinate wire payments with Accounts Payable so no production run is held up on materials.
* Support revenue reporting and billing across both programs: prepare per-order billing paperwork and the monthly Verified invoice tracker to a hard month-close deadline, collect GMV from VaaS partners, maintain the reporting, and follow up on overdue invoices.
* Coordinate design approvals and marketing deliverables, moving box designs through Creative review to written approval before production and getting series checklists published on schedule.
* Be the first line on error handling: intake production, shipping, and inventory problems, triage them, drive them to resolution, and escalate anything with commercial or relationship implications to the Account Manager and Director.
* Keep the program’s trackers, pipeline, and reporting accurate and audit-clean, and pull operational reporting to keep the team current on status.
Identify and execute on key opportunities for continuous process improvement, including working with tech teams to execute.  

  

**Who You Are:**

*Required Qualifications:*

* 4+ years in operations, logistics, supply-chain, fulfillment, or e-commerce coordination, including end-to-end ownership of a recurring operational cadence.
* Proven ability to juggle many parallel workstreams on deadline without dropping threads; you are organized, precise, and comfortable being the person accountable for things shipping on time.
* Comfort owning partner-facing operational communication (shipping status, issue tracking) and revenue/GMV reporting across a portfolio of accounts.
* Strong Google Sheets / spreadsheet skills, and fluency with ticketing or service-desk tools (such as Atlassian/Jira) and procurement or AP systems.
* A calm, resourceful approach to problem-solving; you like untangling errors and coordinating across warehouse, finance, creative, and external partners to get to resolution.
* High school or equivalent education background preferred, or equivalent work experience.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Familiarity with trading cards, collectibles, or the hobby market.
* Experience running recurring procurement (PR/PO) cycles, including with overseas vendors.
* Experience with procurement platforms such as Coupa.
Warehouse or fulfillment-floor exposure.  

  

**Salary Range:**

*The salary range for this position is $121,000-$140,000.

**Cybersecurity Manager**

Welcome to a better way, an authentic way. **Welcome to Nature’s Way.**

We believe that nature is the best way to holistic health, and it should be available to everyone.

When we help people live healthy lives, we build a happier, healthier world for everyone.

How we go about our work drives TRUST in who we are, what we do, and the products we produce.

Our customers trust:

* Our actions to have integrity.

And we’ve been leading the way since 1969.

Be a part of helping people live healthy lives as our new **Cybersecurity Manager.**  
  
**SUMMARY**  
The Cybersecurity Manager leads the day-to-day execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program. This role manages security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, risk reduction, compliance and audit readiness, security awareness, third-party security services, and the operational use of Microsoft security capabilities. The manager works across IT, business teams, and service providers to implement security controls, coordinate remediation, improve detection and response workflows, and strengthen the organization’s security posture while supporting the broader security strategy established by the Director of Cyber Security and IT Operations.  
  
***This role is fully remote.***  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**

* Lead execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program, translating security strategy, policies, standards, and priorities into operational plans.
* Manage vulnerability management activities, including identification, prioritization, coordination of remediation, and reporting of technology risks.
* Lead day-to-day security operations and monitoring, including investigation, escalation, response, documentation, and follow-up for security events and incidents.
* Coordinate incident response activities across IT domains and business functions and support post-incident reviews and corrective actions.
* Maintain audit and assessment readiness by coordinating documentation, evidence collection, control validation, findings response, and remediation tracking.

* Promote security awareness and compliance through communication, education, and support of organization-wide security programs.
* Support the implementation of Operation’s security capabilities such as identity and access management, privileged access, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and email/web security.
* Own the implementation and operation of security capabilities such as logging and monitoring, SIEM/SOAR, and data protection.
* Manage third-party security operations center (SOC) and other security service providers, including service levels, analyst performance, alert quality, portal access, escalation paths, incident coordination, actionable reporting, backup coverage, and continuous improvement.
* Lead the design, development, testing, governance, and continual improvement of security incident response and remediation tools, workflows, automation rules, playbooks, integrations, and reporting to improve detection, triage, containment, recovery, and corrective action while minimizing unintended operational impact.
* Oversee the operational configuration, integration, data quality, alerting, and policy alignment of Microsoft security capabilities, including Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview, and supporting data connectors.
* Establish and govern least-privilege administrative access, privileged identity management, separate administrative accounts, role elevation, and access review practices for security and technology platforms.
* Maintain and improve security policies, processes, procedures, standards, knowledge articles, incident records, and lessons learned to support consistent execution, audit readiness, and organizational knowledge.

* Evaluate emerging threats, technologies, and security practices and recommend practical improvements.
* Mentor and develop Cyber Security staff, provide technical and operational guidance, establish priorities, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with executives, managers, auditors, partners, and subject matter experts.
* Must be highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, or closely related IT roles, including experience leading security initiatives and providing guidance to other security professionals.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks and best practices such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, and CIS Controls.
* Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, identity and access management, endpoint security, logging/SIEM, data protection, secure configuration, and patch management.
* Experience supporting internal or external security audits, assessments, evidence collection, remediation, and compliance activities.
* Knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and cloud technologies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth & tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring a Security Manager to own security across our brands. You will run the security program, lead incident response, and build a small security team as we grow. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set the direction and you still do real technical work.

You report to our Head of Technology and brief our leadership team directly every month. When something goes wrong, you are the person leadership trusts to run the response and explain it in plain language.

What you will own

* Security program. Own the security strategy and roadmap across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, and future brands. Report on security posture and risk to leadership every month.
* Incident response. Own incident response end to end and lead the room during live incidents. Keep runbooks current, run tabletop exercises, and write postmortems leadership can act on.
* Team leadership. Manage and develop our Security Engineer, and build the security team as the company scales.
* Policy and audit readiness. Write and enforce security policies that people actually follow: access control, acceptable use, data handling, vendor review, and incident response. Prepare the company for audits such as SOC 2, working with Legal & Compliance.
* Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training, and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands on social media platforms.
* Platform and account security. Set the security standards for customer accounts on our platforms, including login protection and account-takeover defense, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
* AI and automation security. Set the rules for how AI agents and automations handle credentials, data, and tool permissions, and review high-risk ones before they go live.
* Security tooling and vendors. Own the security stack (SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, identity and device management) and the vendors behind it. Set the device and access standards that IT runs day to day.
* Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind our scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support, and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

 **Requirements**

What you will bring

* 5+ years in security, including at least 2 years leading a security function or serving as senior security personnel at a company of 100+ people.
* Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises.
* Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: policy, tooling, training, and incident response.
* Experience in crypto, fintech, or another high-fraud industry.
* Deep, current knowledge of phishing, social engineering, and impersonation attacks and how to defend against them.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, and identity and device management platforms.
* Can write scripts and automation rather than relying only on vendor UIs.
* Writes clear security policy and gets people to follow it.
* Briefs executives in plain language and trains non-technical staff.
* Comfortable leading in a fully remote team spread across many time zones.

Nice to have

* Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
* Experience securing or evaluating AI agents and LLM-based tools.
* Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, OSTH, or OSCP.

How we hire

Our process ends with every finalist presenting a 90-day security plan to our Head of Technology: what you would look at first, what you would fix, and how you would measure progress.

 **Benefits**

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package
* Independent Contractor opportunity
* Fully remote, globally distributed team.
* Team offsites
* Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results.

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a **Principal Cyber Threat Analyst** to support its CISO & Global Cybersecurity organization's Intelligence and Response (I&R) team.

Northrop Grumman's Intelligence and Response (I&R) team is tasked with a unique cyber mission to provide counterintelligence (CI) and cyber threat protection to Northrop Grumman's intellectual property, networks and sensitive data against a variety of highly skilled adversaries. To accomplish this goal, the I&R team performs daily in-depth analysis of current network and host-based threat activity, assesses trends developing in the future, monitors CI portals and liaisons with Defense Industrial Base and government peers to enhance the protection of the Northrop Grumman Managed Network (NGMN).

* Conduct all-source research on cyber threat actors and intrusion sets (e.g., APTs); evaluate technical and intelligence reporting for cyber threat activities of interest.
* Support informational and analytic products designed to increase situational awareness and advanced warning of current and emerging cyber threats and risks; report on underlying patterns of behavior by conducting detailed analysis of incidents, threats and risks and associated impacts and consequences, vulnerabilities, tactics, techniques and procedures (TTP), and other malicious and non-malicious indicators.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 5 Years of relevant experience with a Bachelors in Science; OR 3 Years with Masters; OR 1 Years with PhD.
* Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, a U.S. Government **Top Secret** level security clearance as a condition of continued employment.
* Must be able to prepare and analyze data and figures.
* Must have experience with two or more analysis tools used in a SOC/CIRT or similar investigative environment.
* Must have a minimum of 2 years of experience conducting analysis of log data in support of intrusion analysis or cybersecurity operations.
* Must have a minimum of 4 years of experience with Python, PowerShell or other scripting language.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A current U.S. Government **Top** **Secret** levelsecurity clearance.
* Demonstrated awareness of current endpoint and network exploits, familiarity with computer network exploitation methodologies and tools.
* Understanding of network communication protocols at all layers of the OSI model.
* Experience working with large data sets, high-performance computing systems, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools.
* Experience working with endpoint detection and response technologies.
* Experience with cyber threat intelligence methodologies.
* Linux/Unix and Windows proficiency, including shell (Bash, PowerShell) scripting.
* Familiarity with current cybersecurity threats facing U.S. defense contractors or the U.S. Government.
* One or more of the following technical certifications (or equivalent) is preferred: GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Health Impact
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst – Health Impact role is an individual contributor responsible for transforming complex operational andhealthcare data into actionable insights. These insightshelp clinical leaders manage day-to-day operations, driveimprovement and deliver greater health and cost outcomes for our members and clients. Reporting to the Director of Clinical Impact, this role serves as the primary analytical engine supporting Health Impact modeling, clinical stratification, engagement funnel performance, and population health strategy. You will partner closely with other Product leaders, Care Delivery Nursing team, and Quality and Health Impact leaders to design and deliver sophisticated analyses that enable data-driven decision-making at every level of the organization.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Support: Design and build analyses and models using claims, UM, and member encounters data to support enterprise strategic decisions for Health Impact and outcomes.Answer strategic analytical questions about which interventions, member cohorts and engagement channels produce the greatest health impact, and where utilization is rising without matching outcome improvement.

* Playbook: Derive insights from analyses and models to drive and prioritize initiatives and interventions that deliver Health Impact. This includes consideration of the end-to-end member engagement funnel, linking engagement,utilization, and conversions to measurable health outcomes and client cost savings.

* Impact Measurement: Create reporting that measures impact delivered and outcomes achieved, including care gap closures, reductions in avoidable or unnecessary care, improvements in site of care, chronic condition management and other short-term drivers of improved health outcomes and cost savings.

* Partnership:Collaborate and partner with central analytics and operational analytics teams to define, validate and evolve impact-oriented KPIs and guardrail metrics that keep the incentive to drive engagement in balance with outcomes. Generate external facing Health Impact data in sync with our broader enterprise client reporting.

**A Day** **In****The** **Life**

* Track leading and lagging indicators: care gap closure, avoidable ED and inpatient use, medication adherence, condition control, total cost of care and member-reported outcomes.

* Design and run outcome studies (quasi-experimental, matched cohort, difference-in-differences) that measure clinical, quality and cost impact.

* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Technology, and Clinical leaders to ensure data assets accurately reflect operational realities and support channel optimization goals.

* Act as the analytical check on initiatives meant to drive utilization by assessing their expected health impact before launch.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Business, or a related quantitative field required; Master's degree preferred.

* **Experience:** 5+ years of progressive experience in data or business analytics, with meaningful exposure to healthcare operations, clinical data, or population health environments.

**Technical Skills**

* **Visualization:** Expert-level proficiency in Tableau; ability to architect and build interactive, self-service dashboards with governance and scalability in mind.

* **Query & Data Engineering:** Advanced SQL scripting (T-SQL, PL/SQL) with demonstrated ability to navigate complex relational schemas, medical claims databases, and multi-source data environments.

* **Cloud & Big Data:** Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses (Amazon Redshift preferred); familiarity with Big Data environments (Hadoop/Hive) a plus, along with experience with Databricks architecture.

* **Advanced Analytics:** Applied experience with predictive modeling, cohort matching, statistical analysis, or machine learning frameworks in a healthcare or operational context.

* **Productivity & Modeling:** High proficiency in Excel for rapid prototyping and ad-hoc modeling; Python a plus.

* **UAT/QA:** Experience in performing UAT/QA processes to ensure accurate, user-friendly reporting and dashboard outputs

**Domain Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of medical claims data structures, clinical outcome metrics, and operational drivers of healthcare cost and utilization.

* Familiarity with population health concepts including care gap identification, member risk stratification, and engagement channel performance measurement.

* Familiar with ROI methods, actuarial approaches and industry standards related to claims trends.

* Stress-tests results with sensitivity analysis and documents assumptions so they hold up under actuarial and consultant review.

**Professional Competencies**

* **Analytical Rigor:** Strong pattern recognition and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with large, complex, and sometimes ambiguous datasets to surface meaningful signals.

* **Actuarial** **Validat****ions**:Analyze healthcare spend and trends to actuarial standards, reconciling claims, eligibility and financial data before results go to clients.

* **Stakeholder Communication:** Proven ability to translate technical methodology and analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical clinical and operational audiences.

* **Initiative & Ownership:** Self-starter with a "roll up your sleeves" mindset; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

* **Collaboration:** Effective cross-functional collaborator in a matrixed organization; able to manage competing stakeholder needs and priorities with professionalism and clarity.

* **Attention to Detail:** High degree of accuracy in data validation, metric definition, and reporting output — recognizing that analytical errors in a clinical context carry real operational conseque

jobs.title: Pricing & Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Established in 2021, **Independence Pet Holdings** is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus, a Doubtless company is seeking a Pricing & Market Intelligence Analyst to lead pricing strategy, market research, competitive intelligence, and commercialization analysis across our growing portfolio of veterinary technology products.

This role will be responsible for developing data-driven pricing recommendations that balance customer value, competitive positioning, product costs, margin objectives, and market opportunities. The position will partner closely with Product, Commercial, Finance, Operations, and Executive Leadership to ensure product pricing and packaging decisions support Clarus' growth strategy and profitability goals. The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strategic thinking and enjoys translating complex market data into actionable business recommendations.

* **Key** **Responsibilities Pricing** **Strategy &** **Commercialization**
  + Develop pricing strategies and recommendations for new and existing Clarus products and services.
  + Evaluate subscription, transaction-based, usage-based, claims-based, and hybrid pricing models.
  + Recommend pricing, packaging, bundling, and commercialization strategies for software and data products.
  + Assess business cases and pricing approaches for new product launches, strategic partnerships, and market expansions.
  + Monitor pricing performance and recommend optimization opportunities to improve revenue growth, adoption, and profitability.
  + Establish pricing governance and pricing approval processes across the product portfolio.

* **Market Research & Competitive Intelligence**
  + Conduct market research to understand customer purchasing behavior, willingness to pay, unmet needs, and market trends.
  + Develop competitive intelligence on veterinary software providers, practice management systems, claims solutions, payment platforms, and emerging market entrants.
  + Analyze competitor pricing models, product offerings, and go-to-market strategies.
  + Identify market opportunities, risks, and industry trends that influence product strategy and commercial decisions.
  + Conduct customer and stakeholder interviews, surveys, and research initiatives to support pricing and product decisions.

* **Financial & Business Analysis**
  + Assess product delivery costs, operating expenses, implementation costs, support costs, and partnership economics to support pricing recommendations.
  + Build financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate pricing alternatives and expected business outcomes.
  + Partner with Finance on revenue forecasts, margin assessments, and long-range planning assumptions.
  + Measure the effectiveness of pricing decisions through adoption, retention, revenue, and profitability metrics.
  + Develop executive-level reports, dashboards, and recommendations for leadership review.

* **Cross-Functional Partnership**
  + Partner with Product Managers throughout the product lifecycle to develop pricing and commercialization strategies.
  + Collaborate with Commercial teams to ensure pricing recommendations align with market realities and customer needs.
  + Support strategic planning, annual operating planning, and product investment prioritization decisions.
  + Partner with M&A, Strategic Partnerships, and Corporate Development teams to assess pricing and market opportunities for acquisitions, partnerships, and new business models.
  + Support product launch readiness activities, including pricing, positioning, and market assessments.

* **Qualifications Education**
  + Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field.
  + MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

* **Experience**
  + 8+ years of experience in pricing strategy, market research, product operations, strategic planning, management consulting, business analysis, or related fields.
  + Experience supporting SaaS, healthcare technology, insurance technology, payments, analytics, AI-enabled products, or platform businesses preferred.
  + Demonstrated experience building business cases, financial models, and pricing recommendations.
  + Experience conducting primary and secondary market research and competitive analysis.

* **Skills**
  + Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities.
  + Ability to synthesize large amounts of market, customer, and financial data into clear recommendations.
  + Exceptional communication and presentation skills with executive audiences.
  + Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
  + Ability to influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  + Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau experience preferred.

* **Success** **Measures Success** **in this role will be measured by:**
  + Revenue and margin impact from pricing initiatives.
  + Accuracy and effectiveness of pricing recommendations.
  + Product launch commercialization readiness.
  + Competitive positioning improvements.
  + Executive adoption of pricing and market recommendations.
  + Quality and timeliness of market intelligence delivered to leadership.
  + Support of strategic planning, investment, and partnership decisions.

Most importantly, we continue to invest in a diverse team of inquisitive top talent who fuel each other’s passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.

 **Job Description**

Lakeshore Learning helps educators and families find tools that make learning meaningful, and great decisions at Lakeshore start with great data.

As a Sales Data Analyst on our Sales Operations team, you'll turn raw data into clear, reliable reporting that our sales and cross-functional teams use every day to make smarter decisions. This is a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in getting the numbers right and telling a clean, honest story with data.

A day on the job looks like this:

* Build, maintain, and distribute sales reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses that track pipeline activity, customer trends, and sales performance.
* Extract and transform data from Salesforce, Data lake and warehouse systems, and business intelligence platforms to support accurate, consistent reporting across the organization.
* Run routine data audits and validation checks to catch gaps, flag inconsistencies, and keep reporting outputs trustworthy.
* Partner with Retail, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Bid, IT, and other teams to understand reporting needs, troubleshoot data issues, and deliver timely insights.
* Document reporting processes, support tool maintenance, and continuously look for ways to improve how we build and share data.

  
**Qualifications**

Required:

* High proficiency in Excel, including Power Query, and experience working with a CRM such as Salesforce
* Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI or a comparable platform
* Demonstrated ability to audit, validate, and maintain data accuracy across reporting workflows

Preferred:

* Experience supporting sales operations or working alongside sales and marketing teams
* Familiarity with data lake environments or enterprise data extraction processes
* Exposure to documenting reporting processes or supporting tool migrations

What sets you apart:

* You catch the error before anyone else does — and you fix it without being asked

* You communicate what the data actually says, not just what stakeholders hoped to hear
* You manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or dropping the ball on routine deliverables

At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.

We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it’s a great experience to be part of. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. To help maintain this high bar for success, we’re constantly on the lookout for people to join us. So if you’re a down-to-earth professional who shares our desire for making a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

### **About the Team:**

Mercury\* is building a complete financial stack for startups, and Risk is how we protect our customers, Mercury, and the broader financial ecosystem. You'll join the Fraud & Disputes Enablement team, a shared-services group that makes our operations teams faster, more consistent, and ready for scrutiny. The team is made up of Quality Control, Learning & Development, and Program Management, and supports Fraud & Disputes.

### **Role Summary:**

This is a generalist program management role for someone who builds programs from zero to one. You'll lead Mercury's Bank Charter Readiness work across Fraud, Disputes, and Risk UX, run the operating reviews and goal tracking that show leaders how Fraud and Disputes are performing, and use data to drive continuous improvement. You'll work with Risk Operations, Compliance, Risk Product, Engineering, Risk Strategy, and Vendor Management, and you'll show the team how AI can help us work smarter, not harder.

* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

### **What You'll Do:**

**Lead Bank Charter Readiness**

* Translate the regulatory expectations of a chartered bank (Reg E, card network rules, and the standards examiners apply) into clear, sequenced work plans owned by the right teams.
* Build Bank Charter Readiness programs from zero to one: define scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks, and report progress to executives.
* Keep teams audit-ready every day, with current SOPs, traceable decisions, defensible evidence, and clean documentation, so exam preparation never becomes a scramble.
* Coordinate responses to regulator, auditor, and partner-bank inquiries with Compliance, Legal, and Operations.

**Lead Goal tracking, and Reporting for Fraud & Disputes**

* Own the cadence and content of Operational Quality Reviews and Monthly CORs Reviews for Fraud and Disputes, from the data pull to the narrative to the follow-up actions.
* Define and track ops health measures and team goals, including OKRs, so leaders can see what is on track, what is at risk, and why.
* Build the reporting and dashboards leaders use to make decisions, and set up new reporting from scratch where none exists.
* Raise risks early, make trade-offs explicit, and drive decisions to closure with partners who don't report to you.

**Use data for continuous improvement**

* Analyze quality, productivity, and compliance data across Fraud, Disputes, and Risk UX to find the patterns behind recurring problems.
* Turn those findings into durable process, tooling, and reporting improvements instead of one-off fixes.
* Work with QC, L&D, and Operations leaders to route root causes to the team that can fix them, and confirm the fix worked.
* Stand up new continuous improvement programs from zero to one and measure their results.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* 5+ years of program management experience in risk, compliance, fraud, disputes, or operations at a bank, fintech, or other regulated financial services company.
* Banking\* experience, with working knowledge of how a regulated institution runs, and direct experience working with regulators, examiners, auditors, or sponsor banks (for example exam preparation, findings remediation, or regulatory responses).
* A record of building programs from zero to one, from ambiguous problem to measurable result, with impact beyond your immediate team.
* 2+ years of experience governing BPO or other outsourced operations, with a focus on governance: SLAs, performance and quality oversight, escalations, and regular business reviews.
* Strong understanding of risk operational processes in Fraud and/or Disputes, such as case handling, investigations, chargebacks, or Reg E error resolution.
* Comfort with data: you can define metrics, build or interpret dashboards, and explain what the numbers mean.
* Experience using AI and automation to improve how work gets done, for example synthesizing evidence and documentation, drafting and maintaining SOPs, analyzing QC and vendor data, summarizing incidents, and automating status reporting.

### **Nice to Haves:**

* Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or above) or equivalent continuous improvement experience
* ISO quality credentials (for example ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Implementer) or a similar quality management background
* PMI certification (PMP, PgMP) or equivalent
* Experience with change management frameworks such as Prosci/ADKAR, or ITIL-style incident and problem management
* Experience in QC program design, workforce management, or learning and development
* Familiarity with card network dispute rules and platforms
* Experience with Risk UX, customer-facing risk flows, in a regulated context
* Experience building and scaling a program in a high-growth environment

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**  
As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you'll be a recognized domain authority and a driving force behind how we scale our technology and grow the business. You'll operate with significant autonomy — defining goals, workstreams, and constraints independently — to lead multi-quarter, high-visibility initiatives that span multiple teams. You'll use judgment across the full delivery lifecycle to make tradeoffs that optimize for the wider organization, not just your own program. Beyond your own initiatives, you'll be a role model and mentor for other TPMs, raising the bar for how program management is done.

**The Impact You'll Make**

* Lead multi-quarter, high-visibility initiatives that span multiple teams, with urgency and ownership — driving new ways of working that get adopted broadly, not just delivering against a scoped plan.
* Drive cross-team collaboration, overseeing planning and execution across programs with multiple dependencies and constraints; act as the connective tissue across Engineering, Product, and other functions. Implement communications standards across your portfolio of programs, including executive and key partner communications.
* Independently identify solutions to ambiguous, complex, cross-program problems, acting with autonomy — and seek out change management opportunities that increase program velocity across multiple teams. Build new processes and mechanisms that scale beyond your own program, increasing efficiency and execution across the org.
* Serve as the operational leader and hub for your embedded team — leading quarterly planning that translates priorities into a scoped, resourced plan, and running MBRs and WBRs with clear status, blockers, and next steps.

jobs.description:
### **Role Overview:**

We're looking for a hands-on Treasury Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day execution of Mercury's cash management and reporting processes. This is an execution- and build-focused role: you'll manage cash movements and approvals, maintain Treasury's core reporting cadence, and — critically — design and build the automated tools and workflows that let Treasury operate without relying on manual spreadsheet work or costly third-party platforms.

We're especially interested in candidates who are fluent with modern AI and prioritize process and reporting automations. If you've automated processes to gain scale and efficiency we want to hear about it.

### **Cash Management & Operations:**

* Execute and approve daily cash movements across Mercury's accounts, ensuring accuracy, proper authorization, and timely settlement
* Maintain daily cash positioning and reporting, tracking balances across operating, reserve, and partner bank accounts
* Manage reserve account funding across Mercury's partner bank relationships, ensuring balances comply with contractual requirements and reconciling reserve calculations against underlying agreements
* Support cash forecasting by maintaining and refreshing short-term cash flow models
* Own bank account access and rights administration

### **Reporting & Automation (Build Focus):**

* Design, build, and maintain automated cash and liquidity reporting — reducing reliance on manual spreadsheet processes and off-the-shelf treasury management tooling
* Build scalable tools for cash positioning, reserve tracking, and reporting workflows
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting packages (e.g., ALCO materials, deposit summaries, liquidity metrics)
* Own data pulls and validation from internal systems (e.g., NetSuite, Snowflake) to support reporting accuracy
* Continuously look for manual, error-prone, or repetitive Treasury processes and propose/build automated replacements

### **Cross-Functional Support:**

* Partner with Accounting to ensure cash activity, reserve movements, and facility transactions are properly reflected in the GL
* Work with Data/Analytics teams to acquire cash data feeds from third-party banks to support Treasury and broader Finance reporting
* Support ALCO and management reporting with accurate, well-formatted, timely inputs
* Assist with ad hoc requests from the Treasurer and broader Finance team

### **What We're Looking For:**

* Prior experience at a fintech, bank, or other regulated financial institution
* 2–5 years of experience in treasury operations, corporate treasury, FP&A, or a related finance/accounting function
* High attention to detail — this role involves approving real money movements and compliance-sensitive reporting
* Strong data modeling skills; comfort with large datasets
* Demonstrated experience thoughtfully transitioning manual processes to scalable automations to gain efficiencies
* Familiarity with SQL and/or willingness to learn (Snowflake, Omni experience a plus)
* Exposure to NetSuite or similar ERP/GL systems a plus
* Strong written communication; comfortable producing clean, concise reporting for senior stakeholders and external counterparties (third-party banks, lenders)
* Self-starter comfortable in an ambiguous, build-as-you-go environment
* Experience using AI tools to prototype automated processes

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience with partner bank / BaaS reserve account structures
* Prior use of Treasury Management Systems
* Familiarity with deposit sweep networks
* Experience supporting Federal Reserve account operations
* Project management skills — this role will involve owning trackers and multi-workstream initiatives

* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

The Global Events Content team is seeking an experienced Event Program Manager to own two content mandates for 1P flagship events: the embargo content lifecycle for confidential launch sessions, and workshop (interactive, hands-on) content and delivery. jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are a specialty vaccine company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs.

We have leveraged our expertise and capabilities both to commercialize three vaccines, including the world’s first and only chikungunya vaccine, and to rapidly advance a broad range of vaccine candidates into and through the clinic, including candidates against Lyme disease and Zika.

Valneva USA is focused on the marketing and distribution of vaccines for Japanese encephalitis and chikungunya.

The Senior Business Operations Manager serves as a U.S. strategic leader responsible for overseeing 3PL and end-to-end vaccine logistics operations across the market. This role drives operational excellence by optimizing distribution networks, enhancing supply reliability, and delivering sustainable cost efficiencies while ensuring full compliance with FDA, CDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

As a key member of the U.S. leadership team, this position aligns logistics and commercial operations with broader corporate strategy to support product launches, government contracting, and ongoing lifecycle management within the vaccine portfolio. The role champions cross-functional collaboration across Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, and Global Supply teams to ensure seamless execution.

With a strong focus on scalability and agility, the Senior Business Operations Manager leverages data-driven insights, process standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies to strengthen supply continuity, mitigate risk, and enable long-term growth in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment.

 **Requirements**

**U.S. Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the U.S. strategic lead for business operations and vaccine logistics, aligning supply chain, finance, commercial, quality, and global teams to deliver operational excellence.
* Provide executive-level performance reporting and insights to the U.S. Head to ensure leadership alignment and data-driven decision-making.
* Lead U.S. contracting operations across government (including Military) and private market partnerships, overseeing financial analytics, compliance, and execution performance.

**Supply Chain & 3PL Oversight**

* Own end-to-end U.S. vaccine supply chain strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives and full compliance with GMP, FDA, and State Board of Pharmacy requirements (serving as Designated Representative nationwide).
* Oversee 3PL distribution operations, including inbound/outbound logistics, cold-chain integrity, inventory control, returns management, and sales order administration.
* Partner with global supply chain on demand planning, transfer pricing, U.S. Customs coordination, and inventory optimization to minimize expiry risk and protect supply continuity.
* Lead engagement with wholesalers and distributors, ensuring contract compliance, inventory discipline, issue resolution, and regulatory adherence.

**Pricing, Government Reporting & Contract Administration**

* Direct pricing governance and contract administration, including distributor agreements, rebate management, chargebacks, and customer compliance.
* Calculate and submit required U.S. government pricing reports (e.g., NFAMP, FCP), ensuring accuracy and regulatory adherence.
* Implement and operationalize new pricing structures, membership agreements, and commercial contracts.

**Sales & Commercial Operations Support**

* Oversee sales analytics and reporting infrastructure, managing data sources and remote analyst teams to deliver actionable insights.
* Partner with the GM and Sales Leadership on incentive compensation reporting and commercial performance tracking.

**Quality & Compliance Leadership**

* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to maintain rigorous regulatory standards across 3PL and distribution operations both for the US and alignment globally.
* Proactively identify and mitigate compliance, logistics, and operational risks.
* Embed continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, scalability, and control.

**U.S. Business Operations Management**

* Lead administrative and operational infrastructure for the U.S. entity, including HR benefits oversight, vendor and fleet management, office operations, and employee onboarding.
* Manage cost controls across operational budgets while maintaining high service levels and employee engagement.
* Support organizational effectiveness through coordination of meetings, trainings, and cross-functional initiatives.

  
**Benefits**

Good team spirit in a strong and highly motivated team
